title: potentilla chrysantha var. buquoyana
intro: Potentilla chrysantha var. buquoyana, commonly known as Golden Potentilla, is a variety of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as digestive issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of Golden Potentilla include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit wound-healing properties, and exhibit antiproliferative effects against cancer cells. The bioactive constituents present in Golden Potilla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
